title: Build the Magic Bento workspace Home
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Build the four-section React Bits Home with up to three projects, up to three recently opened apps, a File Explorer entry and an Activity panel. Show-all actions open basic Projects and Apps views backed by real member data. Projects start as designated folders and Apps documents its inventory scope. Activity explains source availability.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-047 for nested discovery, WI-051 for the explorer entry, and the session boundary for member-owned state.

**Verify** · Verify one-action opening, deliberate app recency, two-member isolation, stable focus and Back, mobile stacking and truthful empty/unavailable states.

**Delivery** · v0.2 client, existing PR #9.
